title: NIST WebBook: Hydrogen is H2, molecular weight 2.01588 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Hydrogen as H2, molecular weight 2.01588 amu, CAS 1333-74-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Hydrogen, CAS Registry Number 1333-74-0, lists molecular formula H2 and molecular weight 2.01588 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 2.01565006414 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H2/h1H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
